name: nspb-rest-toolkit-remote
description: Remote MCP server (Netlify Functions) for nspb-rest-toolkit -- multi-customer SaaS surface for claude.ai and Claude Desktop's remote connector flow. The pip-installable Python package at src/nspb_rest_toolkit is the separate local/stdio surface (Claude Code plugin, Claude Desktop .mcpb extension) -- this directory is additive, not a replacement.
